# Baobab of Underwriting (`baobab-of-underwriting`)

Acquisition underwriting packet for a nursing home: trailing-twelve-month summary with one-time items and the management fee normalized, occupancy and payer mix, a staffing model, a year-one projection, value at your cap rate, and the receivables valued by payer and age. Arithmetic on your numbers, not an appraisal. Resident names in the aging are masked before results reach the model.

**Baobab never sends a letter of intent, an offer or a term sheet.**

Evergreen ver 1 · Acquisitions and underwriting · MIT · Node 20 or newer · local files only · resident and staff identifiers masked before results reach the model · built on [`evergreen-core`](../evergreen-core)

```bash
npx -y baobab-of-underwriting demo
npx -y baobab-of-underwriting mcp --root ./facility-files
```

## What the sample data shows

A fictional 120-bed nursing home, T12 April 2025 to March 2026, with a 12.5% cap rate. Planted:

- September 2025 is missing from the T12, so recurring lines are annualized from 11 months.
- A 180,000 provider relief fund receipt (found by its name) and a 65,000 legal settlement (flagged one-time) come out of normalized EBITDAR.
- The seller charged a 3% management fee; the buyer underwrites 5%.
- Staffing 3.8 nursing hours per resident day at 38 an hour costs about 249,000 more a year than the T12 shows.
- Occupancy is 77% (92 average daily census) against an 85% target, and normalized EBITDAR covers rent 1.25 times against a 1.3 floor.
- A 210-day Medicaid pending balance is the largest receivables haircut.

Resident names and ids in the aging are in [`phi-canaries.json`](fixtures/phi-canaries.json); they must never reach the model. The packet carries no resident names. [`rules-typo.json`](fixtures/rules-typo.json) writes `cap` for `cap_rate`, so the check refuses it.

## Tools

| Tool | What it does | Policy |
|---|---|---|
| `baobab_check` | Build the underwriting packet: T12, normalization, occupancy, payer mix, staffing, year one, value and receivables, with the items to diligence. | runs |
| `baobab_write_report` | Write baobab-underwriting.csv (one row per item, with blank owner and decision columns) and baobab-underwriting.html into out_dir (default evergreen-out/baobab). | runs |
| `baobab_recall` | Search this agent's own memory of the customer's setup: accepted facts (in use) and facts waiting for a person. | runs |
| `baobab_learn` | Propose one fact about the customer's setup for this agent to remember. | runs |
| `baobab_accept_learning` | A named person accepts or rejects a fact waiting in this agent's memory. | one named click, even in Auto (`accept_learning`) |
| `baobab_retire_memory` | A named person stops an accepted fact from applying. | one named click, even in Auto (`accept_learning`) |
| `loi_send` | Baobab never sends a letter of intent, an offer or a term sheet. | refused |

Any tool name not in this table is blocked, including names a model invents. Refused tools are listed so a model can see they exist and are refused.

### `baobab_check` arguments

| Argument | What it is |
|---|---|
| `t12` (required) | Trailing twelve months under --root: month (YYYY-MM), account, group (revenue, nursing_labor, other_labor, non_labor, management_fee, rent, other), amount, one-time flag |
| `census` (required) | Patient days by month and payer: month, payer, payer type, days |
| `ar` | Optional receivables aging: resident, payer, payer type, age in days, balance |
| `assumptions` (required) | Assumptions JSON: beds, cap_rate, mgmt_fee_pct, growth, occupancy_target, min_rent_coverage, staffing, collect, one_time_accounts |
| `status` | Only items with this status |
| `limit` | Most items to return to the model (the report file always has all of them) |

## Columns it reads

Tables can be CSV, TSV, semicolon- or pipe-separated text, Excel `.xlsx`, JSON or JSONL. Columns are matched by the names below (any case and punctuation), and by their usual names in German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Japanese, Chinese and Korean. Dates become `YYYY-MM-DD`. Columns marked *masked* hold resident or staff identifiers.

The PointClickCare, MatrixCare and American HealthTech style names were written from public help pages and general knowledge, **not checked against real exports**. Run `npx baobab-of-underwriting inspect <file>` (column names and shapes only, never values) and name any column it misses in `remedy-sources.json`.

### Trailing twelve months (`t12`)

| Column | Type | Read from |
|---|---|---|
| `month` (required) | text | Month, Period, Fiscal Month |
| `account` (required) | text | Account, Account Name, Line, Description, GL Account |
| `group` | text | Group, Category, Type, Section |
| `amount` (required) | amount | Amount, Amt, Total, Balance, Net Amount, Payment Amount, Paid, Paid Amount |
| `one_time` | text | One Time, One-Time, Non Recurring, Adjust |

### Patient days by month (`census`)

| Column | Type | Read from |
|---|---|---|
| `month` (required) | text | Month, Period, Fiscal Month |
| `payer` (required) | text | Payer, Payer Name, Primary Payer, Pay Source, Payer Source, Payor, Payor Name, Insurance |
| `payer_type` | text | Payer Type, Payor Type, Payer Class, Payer Category, Pay Type |
| `days` (required) | number | Days, Patient Days, Resident Days, Census Days |

### Receivables aging (`ar`)

| Column | Type | Read from |
|---|---|---|
| `resident_id` | text (masked) | Resident ID, Resident #, Resident Number, Res ID, Res #, MRN, Medical Record Number, Client ID |
| `resident_name` | text (masked) | Resident, Resident Name, Name, Patient, Patient Name, Client Name, Resident Full Name |
| `payer` (required) | text | Payer, Payer Name, Primary Payer, Pay Source, Payer Source, Payor, Payor Name, Insurance |
| `payer_type` | text | Payer Type, Payor Type, Payer Class, Payer Category, Pay Type |
| `age_days` | number | Age, Age Days, Days Outstanding, Days Old, Aging Days |
| `balance` (required) | amount | Balance, Amount, Open Balance, Outstanding |

## Settings file (`baobab_assumptions`)

A small JSON file you pass by path. A misspelled setting is refused by name rather than ignored, so a typo never silently changes a check.

| Setting | What it does |
|---|---|
| `beds` (required) | Licensed beds |
| `cap_rate` (required) | Your cap rate on year-one EBITDAR, e.g. 0.125 |
| `mgmt_fee_pct` | Management fee to underwrite, percent of revenue (default 5) |
| `revenue_growth_pct` | Year-one revenue growth, percent (default 3) |
| `expense_growth_pct` | Year-one expense growth, percent (default 4) |
| `occupancy_target` | Occupancy below this is flagged (default 0.85) |
| `min_rent_coverage` | Rent coverage floor (default 1.3) |
| `staffing` | Staffing model: nursing hours per resident day and loaded cost per hour |
| `collect` | Collection rates by payer type, overriding the defaults |
| `one_time_accounts` | Account names to treat as one-time |

## Memory

`baobab_learn` only proposes a fact; nothing changes until a named person accepts it with `baobab_accept_learning`, which is one click even in Auto. Facts live in a hash-chained file under `.remedy/memory/`; if the chain does not verify, no fact is used. Credentials, personal identifiers and text that reads like instructions to an AI are refused.

| Kind | What an accepted fact does |
|---|---|
| `deal_note` | is shown with results. It never changes the numbers. |

## Install

Node 20 or newer. No other runtime dependencies besides `evergreen-core` and `remedy-core`.

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "baobab-of-underwriting": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": [
        "-y",
        "baobab-of-underwriting",
        "mcp",
        "--root",
        "/path/to/facility-files"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

Claude Code: `claude mcp add baobab-of-underwriting -- npx -y baobab-of-underwriting mcp --root .`, or use the plugin files in this folder.

## CLI

```bash
baobab-of-underwriting tools                 # every tool, its policy and arguments
baobab-of-underwriting sources               # the columns each input is read from
baobab-of-underwriting inspect <file>        # how a file would be read (names and shapes, never values)
baobab-of-underwriting call baobab_check '{"t12":"<t12>","census":"<census>","assumptions":"<assumptions>"}'
baobab-of-underwriting eval                  # the private eval cases on the fictional fixtures
baobab-of-underwriting demo
```

## Resident and staff data

Results go to an AI model, so identifiers are masked before they leave the agent: resident and staff names become stable pseudonyms such as `PT-3f9a1c2e`, record and account numbers become `MRN-…` or `ACCT-…`, and e-mails and phone numbers are removed, also inside free text. Report files written to disk keep real names because staff work from them: keep them in a folder only your staff can open. The shared tests check that no fictional identifier from the fixtures reaches any eval result, and the hostile-input check plants spreadsheet formulas, HTML and AI-aimed instructions in the data. This keeps PHI away from the model; it is **not** a HIPAA compliance determination. Your business associate agreements, access controls and policies still apply.

## Limits

- Reads only the files you give it. It does not log in to PointClickCare, MatrixCare, a payer portal, a bank, a state Medicaid portal or a payroll system.
- Medicare, Medicaid and payroll rules are summarised from public material as of 2026 and the numbers are settings you supply; a billing, payroll or legal professional checks them before you rely on them.
- Not legal, tax, accounting, clinical, reimbursement or HIPAA advice. A person decides what to bill, pay, appeal, file or send.
- Every call is written to a hash-chained audit log under `.remedy/` in the root. No network calls, no telemetry, no credentials. The bundled data is fictional.
